verdict_reason: Present PE is 3.5x the historical median and near the top of its 7-year positive-earnings range; the 'cheap vs Shiller' read is an artifact of two prior loss years dragging the 10yr average EPS toward zero, not a real signal.
devils_advocate: NPL/Total Loans rose from 3.07% (FY078-079) to 14.43% (FY081-082) and core capital fell from 22.38% to 9.23% over the same span, with two consecutive loss years (080-081: -11.77, 081-082: -17.70) preceding this year's positive EPS. The market is pricing FY082-083's return to profit as a durable turnaround at near-record multiples before any sustained asset-quality recovery has been shown.
